view.description: workspaces: only the change workspaces (networks with a parent), each with its creator, created time, retention and snapshot counts by trigger for the page asked for

x-values.networks: every network the login can see (default)
x-values.workspaces: only the change workspaces, with creator, retention and snapshot counts by trigger for the page asked for
x-values.primary: the networks that are not change workspaces (no parent)

name.description: keep the networks whose name contains this text (case-insensitive substring) or whose id is exactly this; the finding says how many networks and workspaces the login sees in all, so a capped page is never read as none
